shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: To have enough money to pay for something.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ဝယ်ယူရန် ငွေကြေးတတ်နိုင်သည်
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: We cannot afford a new computer this month.

records.editorial_risk: Money-ability meaning with can/could or negative construction; do not confuse with formal afford somebody something or cannot afford to risk.

dictionary_sense_lead.editorial_interpretation: The first Oxford verb sense is financial ability, often in negative/modal constructions; original 'cannot afford a new computer' is grammatically aligned.
